var script = `
import re, os
ns_a='{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main}'
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
A='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main'
P='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main'
R='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'
def txt(el):
    return ''.join(t.text or '' for t in el.iter(f'{{{A}}}t'))
for n in range(1,7):
    f=f'ppt/slides/slide{n}.xml'
    t=ET.parse(f); root=t.getroot()
    tree=root.find(f'.//{{{P}}}cSld/{{{P}}}spTree')
    print(f'===== SLIDE {n} =====')
    for ch in tree:
        tag=ch.tag.split('}')[1]
        if tag in ('nvGrpSpPr','grpSpPr'): continue
        nv=ch.find(f'.//{{{P}}}cNvPr')
        name=nv.get('name') if nv is not None else '?'
        xfrm=ch.find(f'.//{{{A}}}xfrm')
        off=sz=None
        if xfrm is not None:
            o=xfrm.find(f'{{{A}}}off'); e=xfrm.find(f'{{{A}}}ext')
            if o is not None: off=(int(o.get('x')),int(o.get('y')))
            if e is not None: sz=(int(e.get('cx')),int(e.get('cy')))
        ph=ch.find(f'.//{{{P}}}ph')
        phs=ph.get('type') if ph is not None else None
        print(f'  [{tag}] name={name!r} ph={phs} off={off} ext={sz}')
        tb=ch.find(f'.//{{{P}}}txBody')
        if tb is not None:
            print('      text=', repr(txt(tb))[:300])
`;

from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
im = Image.open('/tmp/deck/ppt/media/image6.png').convert('RGB')
a = np.array(im).astype(float)
g = a.mean(axis=2)
H,W = g.shape
print('H,W',H,W)
# lineness for vertical lines
d = 8
score_col = np.zeros(W)
for x in range(d, W-d):
    col = g[:,x]; l = g[:,x-d]; r = g[:,x+d]
    score_col[x] = np.mean((col > l+10) & (col > r+10))
score_row = np.zeros(H)
for y in range(d, H-d):
    row = g[y,:]; u = g[y-d,:]; dn = g[y+d,:]
    score_row[y] = np.mean((row > u+10) & (row > dn+10))
def tops(s, thr=0.45):
    idx = [i for i in range(len(s)) if s[i] > thr]
    groups=[]; cur=[]
    for i in idx:
        if cur and i-cur[-1]<=4: cur.append(i)
        else:
            if cur: groups.append(cur)
            cur=[i]
    if cur: groups.append(cur)
    return [(int(round(np.mean(gp))), round(max(s[j] for j in gp),2)) for gp in groups]
print('VERT lines:', tops(score_col))
print('HORZ lines:', tops(score_row))
print('--- lower thr ---')
print('VERT:', tops(score_col, 0.25))
print('HORZ:', tops(score_row, 0.25))
`;
